snippet.title: Second Coat Trailer - Coming to PS5 in 2025
snippet.description:
Trailer for Second Coat, coming to PlayStation 5 in 2025. 

Welcome to the adrenaline-fueled world of Second Coat, where vibrant colors collide, strategy reigns supreme, and every splatter counts. In this intense urban paintball game, you’ll need determination, focus, and a steady trigger finger.
